play.held_by: wall pocket + lip over USB-C socket + back stop + 2 snap hooks
3-wall pocket + case wall; foam pad under the OLED
micro-USB edge in a wall pocket, side walls, ramp catch, 2 snap nubs
pocket walls + back rib + snap nubs
flange inside wall; switch behind it
4 printed pegs through its holes; clamped by lid posts

assembly.how: Tilt the board ~35°, slide its USB-C socket under the wall lip, press the back end down until the 2 hooks click.
Hold it 3 mm away from the right wall, lower it, then push it toward the wall: the micro-USB goes into its opening and the board clicks over the ramp.
Lay the diode (in heat-shrink) in the free space in the middle.
Lay the battery in its pocket along the front wall.
Stick a 1 mm foam pad on top of the battery (yours already has one).
Drop each cap inside the back wall and push its plunger out through the hole.
Press each 6×6 switch down into its pocket behind the cap; nubs click over it.
Lay the OLED glass-up so the 4 printed pegs go through its corner holes.
Press the lid on until it clicks (5 snap bumps). To open: fingernail in the notch on the front edge.
